<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex119012024-11-2216-48-49" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> <milestone n="colophon" unit="section"/>
                <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5495"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3761">mngon pa mdzod</rs> kyi rnam bshad gsal ba'i sgron me</rs> zhes bya ba 'di | rigs rus yon tan du <lb n="111a2"/> ma'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho bar gyur cing sde snod 'dzin pa chen po yang dag pa yongs kyi <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6981">dge ba'i <abbr>bshes gnyen</abbr> dge 'dun mgon</rs> gyis bskul ba'i ngor dang ¦ don du gnyer ba du ma la phan pa'i <lb n="111a3"/> phyir du | mngon pa'i sde snod la cud 'dris shing ¦ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4008">bka' bzhi pa <abbr>rin chen</abbr> sangs rgyas mgon</rs> dang ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4080">lo ts+tsha ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang po</rs>'i gsung gi bdud rtsi <lb n="111a4"/> myangs pa | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4129">zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams 'phel</rs> zhes bya bas lcags mo yos kyi lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig<note type="editorial">Date: In the year of the iron-female rat, on the first day of the first Tibetan month, i.e., 1411.</note> la rdzogs par bris pa'o ||
          'dis bstan pa dang <abbr>sems can</abbr> la phan thogs <lb n="111a5"/> par gyur cig || ||</seg></TEI>
